title: Profile helper text button text dark on dark theme
symptom: When using the profile helper in the current Dev build, the button at the top of the screen shows black text on a dark background so it is barely visible. This is suspected to be not adjusting to dark mode.
cause: The issue is linked to the ProfileHelperAppTheme style. If the theme is a Material theme, the general Button becomes a MaterialButton, and on a MaterialButton the background attribute alone will not work; app:backgroundTint should do it.
fix: The fix is to use app:backgroundTint instead of background for the button in the ProfileHelperAppTheme style.
evidence_quote: Issue behind this: If the theme is a Material theme, the general Button will become a MaterialButton. On a `MaterialButton` the `background` attribute alone will not work. `app:backgroundTint` should do it.
